title: Collapse adjacent duplicates
prompt:
Remove **consecutive** duplicate characters, keeping the first of each run ("aabbca" → "abca"). Only *adjacent* equal characters collapse; non-adjacent duplicates stay. Implement `process(String s)`.

Examples: `"aabbca"` → `"abca"`, `""` → `""`, `"aaa"` → `"a"`.

tests.name: collapsed runs
tests.hint: Append charAt(i) only when it differs from charAt(i-1); seed with charAt(0).
